knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic onboarding records
knowledge.detail: Fixed applications, verification statuses, KYC document rules, products, owners, dates, and amounts support deterministic demos.

knowledge.name: Onboarding controls and review rules
knowledge.detail: Packaged guidance defines evidence routing, regulated boundaries, demo anchors, missing-evidence handling, and human gates.

intelligence_processing.name: KYC evidence review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes identity, OFAC, PEP, adverse-media, source-of-wealth, and enhanced-due-diligence evidence without clearing checks.

intelligence_processing.name: Document readiness assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds applicant-specific individual or business checklists, including beneficial-ownership evidence, for authorized KYC and AML review.

intelligence_processing.name: Account setup preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Presents setup-ready applications, product terms, fees, rates, and features without opening or provisioning accounts.

intelligence_processing.name: Onboarding workflow analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Consolidates application status, risk, assets, ownership, bottlenecks, and next-review context across the synthetic pipeline.

intelligence_processing.name: Deterministic routing and calculation
intelligence_processing.detail: Routes four operations, rejects unknown identifiers, calculates KYC completion and pipeline totals, and avoids substitution.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access for onboarding, relationship, compliance, and leadership personas in a Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs FSCustomerOnboardingAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with a single read-only tool and bundled synthetic data.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first review outputs
clients_user_interface.detail: Shows application evidence, checks, missing items, prepared configuration, ownership, limits, and the authorized reviewer.

management_reporting.name: KYC and enhanced-due-diligence review
management_reporting.detail: Reports progress and unresolved PEP, adverse-media, address, beneficial-ownership, or source-of-wealth items for review.

management_reporting.name: Application pipeline and ownership overview
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes status counts, application risk, requested product, assets, bottlenecks, and relationship-manager ownership.

management_reporting.name: Setup and document readiness review
management_reporting.detail: Surfaces setup-review-ready files, product configuration references, required documents, optional documents, and compliance-review handoffs.

tools.name: Portable RAPP Customer Onboarding Agent
tools.detail: Single-file FSCustomerOnboardingAgent implements four read-only operations with synthetic records and no external side effects.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational package with two knowledge files and four skills; validated artifacts remain Draft and unpublished.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 onboarding or CRM case data
tools.detail: Approved future seam for onboarding cases and ownership; it is not connected in the current synthetic package.

tools.name: SharePoint controlled-document library
tools.detail: Approved future seam for governed onboarding documents; the current package uses bundled synthetic knowledge instead.

tools.name: Approved identity and sanctions-screening services
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for identity, OFAC, PEP, and related evidence; no live verification or clearance is configured.

tools.name: Core-banking provisioning workflow
tools.detail: Future authorization-gated seam for account and service provisioning; the current agent only prepares review references.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams approvals
tools.detail: Future review and escalation seam for authorized personnel; no approval, outreach, message, or external action is configured.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by deployment environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used for conversational routing and response generation.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only packaged fictional records and forbids browsing, enrichment, inference, substitution, or invention when evidence is absent.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes KYC evidence review, account setup preparation, document readiness, and onboarding pipeline requests to explicit handlers.

supporting_features.name: Regulated decision-support boundary
supporting_features.detail: Provides no legal, regulatory, lending, tax, investment, financial, or compliance advice and does not claim KYC satisfaction.

supporting_features.name: Authorized human review gates
supporting_features.detail: Requires onboarding, relationship, KYC or AML, identity-verification, and provisioning reviewers before consequential action.

supporting_features.name: Read-only workflow governance
supporting_features.detail: Prevents identity clearance, applicant decisions, outreach, account opening, provisioning, approvals, transactions, and record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked evidence and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Preserves four persona-language cases and records all four passing with only FSCustomerOnboardingAgent loaded under strict isolation.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Keeps validated Copilot Studio agents unpublished, removes web search, and requires separate confirmation before publication.
